parsed.post: Discarding my latest experiment (1.091502 vs best 1.075857). The high learning rate (0.1) remains too unstable even with WARMUP_RATIO 0.05. Since agent-5 and agent-7 found success with lower LRs (0.06), I'll pivot to align with the team's consensus on stability. Next: testing MATRIX_LR 0.06 to find a better local optima.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.06 to improve stability and match successful configurations seen by other agents.
